design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (recovery_repossession_and_reinstatement, env_0072). Revision 3 (policy audit rounds 1-2 closed; see rework_claims_r2.md and rework_claims_r3.md).
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,4,5] -> recovery_ext_agency_fee=4, recovery_ext_redemption_expense_payment=4, recovery_ext_sale_notice_period=5.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only to pay the repossession-side charges himself while his credit union wires the payoff. The agent must read that the redemption expense payment waits on the agency fee being posted and on the notice stating the latest earliest sale date allowing the class minimum notice period, see that neither holds (no involuntary_repossession_fee row; the only notice gives 8 days), post the fee (4 factors), mail the corrected notice (5 factors), then work the payment (4 storage factors) on the world those writes produce, and hand it over.
SCOPE: task 0 claims recovery_ext_agency_fee, recovery_ext_sale_notice_period, recovery_ext_redemption_expense_payment; task 1 claims the surrender fee and the reinstatement expense payment. Disjoint, jointly complete.
PROBLEM TREE: root recovery_ext_redemption_expense_payment (owner=user). Edge 1 -> recovery_ext_agency_fee, value_input, gate posted_open, state form (negated): 'On a case whose vehicle an agency recovered involuntarily, the redemption expense payment is not fixed until the agency's involuntary repossession fee stands posted on the case.'. False at opening: the case is involuntary_recovery and its expense rows are transport 458d59d9-04da-421b-9d03-61ad6c544c1a 275.00, a duplicate transport 275.00 already removed as assessed_in_error, and reconditioning 420.00 and 310.00; none is an involuntary_repossession_fee. The single writer of that fee is the agency fee tool. Edge 2 -> recovery_ext_sale_notice_period, value_input, gate end_offset, state form (affirmative): 'The redemption expense payment is fixed only after the latest earliest sale date stated on the case is stated by at least one notice of intent to sell that allows the class minimum notice period between its own mailing date and that date.'. False at opening: the only notice 4f97c2d8-b055-4f03-8116-68d792647af9 was mailed 2026-10-06 stating 2026-10-14 (8 days < 15). The single writer is the notice tool. The two prerequisite writes commute. Deletion sensitivity (recomputed by check_compute): skip fee -> 1293.00; skip notice -> 1737.00; gold 1897.00.
FACTOR CARD.
recovery_ext_agency_fee (baseline: class involuntary_repossession_fee_usd 600.00): state_fee_ceiling tier 'the contract's state_code is one of limit_states_a' (WI) -> 500.00 (sens 704.00); book_value_reduction tier 'the book value is at least low_value_threshold_usd but below mid_value_threshold_usd' (9800.00) -> taper 66.00 (sens 670.00); keyless_handling tier 'keys_obtained is false, no key_replacement_fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow_equipment is flatbed or medium_duty_flatbed' -> 95.00 (sens 509.00); weekend_recovery tier 'the recovery_date fell on a Sunday' -> 75.00 (sens 529.00). Result 604.00; all-baseline 600.00; the agency_fee_minimum_usd floor does not bind. Near-miss: the 2025 case's agency fee 434.00 is on the closed case (Monday, keyed).
recovery_ext_sale_notice_period (baseline 15 calendar days): state_period_convention tier 'the contract's state_code is one of business_day_notice_states' (WI) -> 16 (sens 44); military_service_days tier 'at least one rate_cap_applied row and no fewer rate_cap_ended rows (left service)' -> 10 (sens 35); reissue_days tier 'the case already carries exactly one notice of intent to sell' -> 7 (sens 38); late_mailing_days tier 'the notice is mailed more than late_mailing_long_days calendar days after the recovery_date' (15 days after recovery) -> 7 (sens 38); funds_arrangement_days tier 'the contract's certified_funds_only is true' -> 5 (sens 40). Result 45 (earliest sale date 2026-12-03); all-baseline 15. Near-misses: the 2025 case's notice is on another case and is not in the per-case count; the returned payments ['3601a1bd-2169-4c9e-a373-9d7c638221c1', '5decf54d-2105-4e48-9224-ccc0bd71d592'] would give the recent-return tier only while certified_funds_only is false.
recovery_ext_redemption_expense_payment (baseline: posted open + class 50.00 x (days from the day after recovery - class 2 grace)): lot_day_rate tier 'the contract's state_code is one of rate_states_a' (WI) -> 20.00 (sens 2167.00); lot_grace_days tier 'the case's storage_lot is one of extended_grace_lots and the payment date is no more than extended_grace_window_days calendar days after the recovery_date' (Lakeshore, payment 15 days after recovery) -> 5 (sens 1993.00); storage_clock_start tier 'the recovery_method is not impound_release and the recovery_date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday' -> held 14 (sens 1929.00); keyless_lot_handling tier 'keys_obtained is false, no key_replacement_fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow_equipment is flatbed or medium_duty_flatbed' -> 12.00/day (sens 1789.00). Result 1897.00; all-baseline 2259.00. Near-misses: the duplicate transport fee is offset by its removal; the 2025 settlement 829.00 is on the closed case.
CROSS-DIFFICULTY: contract state_code, vehicle_book_value_usd, certified_funds_only (CFIELD); contract_servicing_events SCRA rows and contract_transactions returned payments (XCOUNT); all seeded on contract a7f73cd4-51e5-44fa-8c2e-69ec11321b52. MULTI-SOURCE: keyless_handling and keyless_lot_handling each combine keys_obtained on the case, the absence of a key_replacement_fee row in the case activity and the class tow_equipment parameter.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: fee and notice need recovered status (expense_case_status, notice_case_status): case status recovered. The payment's base status gate is retired by the declared overwrite naming both borrower expense payments. The earliest-sale-date clauses of base recovery_reinstatement and recovery_disposition are retired by the sale-notice overwrites: the earliest sale date is the latest deadline_date among the case's notices whose own deadline falls at least the minimum period after their own mailing date; short notices never set or move it. No temporal eligibility applies to the three writes.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target case c168a07f-1769-44f2-95a4-256962dea9a6; posted_open sums this case's expense, removal and settlement rows only; the 2025 case 7f57c173-fdfb-45fa-94f8-559034974dfe rows are excluded by case id; reconditioning 420.00 + 310.00 are sale-preparation expenses a redemption pays (UCC 9-615(a)(1), 9-623).
SEED: contract simulated from origination 2023-03-14 (48 x 361.99 at 23.49%, SCRA 6% cap 2023-08-13..2025-03-12, 2025 default and reinstatement, returns 2026-01-14 and 2026-04-15 with returned-payment fees of 25.00 and 35.00 under the published fee rules (restriction review, subsequent-return charge, autopay offset), 2025 late charges 5.43, 9.95, 14.48 and 2026 late charges 5.43, 11.76, 16.29 as late charges priced by the published contract late-charge rule (5.0% of 361.99 less the combined autopay and first-delinquency reductions)). Every row of the 2025 case is priced by the current rules as of its own date: cure notice 2025-06-11 (15 days, 2 installments + late charges 5.43 + 9.95 = 739.36), agency fee 2025-07-01 434.00, transport 275.00, notice of intent to sell 2025-07-01 (26 days, stating 1824.83 because reinstatement was then available), borrower expense payment 2025-07-08 829.00 = 434.00 + 275.00 + 6 storage days at 20.00. Dealer agreement id is null (dealer profile cannot enter the closure).
PERSONA: Calvin Pemberton; volunteers the repossession, the letter showing no reinstatement amount, the credit union's wired payoff and the wish to pay the repossession side himself by debit card (a certified channel); credentials on request; reactive consent only; pays exactly the stated amount; ends at the confirmation.
STANDARD SOLUTION: verify; read contract, cases, contract-wide activity, ledger, servicing rows and the SCRA request; post fee 604.00; mail notice 45 days / 0.00; hand over payment 1897.00.
VERIFICATION: all values, factor sensitivities and baselines recomputed by check_compute.py (COMPUTE OK).
user_scenario: You are Calvin Pemberton, 40, a Milwaukee caterer and Army veteran who left active duty in March 2025. Harborline Acceptance financed the 2014 Ford E-350 passenger van you use for your catering jobs, and an agency took it from in front of your building on Sunday, October 4. You open the call a little tired but polite: your van was repossessed, the letter you got said there is no reinstatement amount for you this time, and your credit union, Brew City Federal Credit Union, has approved a loan and will wire Harborline the payoff on the contract itself. What you want from this call is to pay, yourself and today, the repossession side of the bill, whatever Harborline charges on the repossession case for getting and holding the van, so nothing on that side holds up the release; you are not asking about the loan payoff, the credit union is handling that. If the representative tells you something has to be updated, charged or mailed on Harborline's side of the case, you say that is fine with you and let them go ahead. You only give your details when asked: your phone number is 4145550142, the last four of your Social Security number are 3417 and your ZIP code is 53215; if asked for the account number you read 7230418265 off your statement, and if asked about the vehicle you say it is the 2014 Ford E-350 van. You will pay with your own debit card; if the representative asks how you want to pay, say debit card, and if they ask for an email you say you would rather not give one. You do not know what the figure should be and you never suggest one. When the representative tells you the amount and hands you the payment step to complete yourself, you complete it for exactly the amount they gave you and read back the confirmation you see. Once the representative confirms your payment has gone through on the repossession case, you thank them and end the call.
